question: Given that $\binom{17}{7}=19448$, $\binom{17}{8}=24310$ and $\binom{17}{9}=24310$, calculate $\binom{19}{9}$.
solution:
Pascal's identity gives C(n,k) = C(n−1,k−1) + C(n−1,k), by splitting the k-element subsets according to whether they contain a fixed element. Thus C(18,8) = C(17,7) + C(17,8) = 19448 + 24310 = 43758. Similarly, C(18,9) = C(17,8) + C(17,9) = 24310 + 24310 = 48620. Applying the identity once more gives C(19,9) = C(18,8) + C(18,9) = 43758 + 48620 = 92378.
Final answer: 92378
